name: Yu Yu Hakusho EDs x Dandadan OP (Otonoke) Flow Music Pack
description: 2 original monetization-safe Flow Music briefs fusing 90s YYH ending-credits warmth with Dandadan Otonoke occult bounce.

tracks.title: SPIRIT FREQUENCY (Sunset Bounce)
tracks.genre: 90s Anime Sunset City-Pop x Modern Occult Hip-Hop Bounce
tracks.cueNotes: Fuses YYH Ending Credits warm Rhodes/sax sunset nostalgia with Dandadan Otonoke syncopated bounce bass and rhythmic vocal hooks.
tracks.prompt: 114 BPM in D minor. Fuses nostalgic 1993 Japanese anime ending credits warmth (glossy DX7 synth chimes, velvety Fender Rhodes seventh chords, smoky late-night tenor saxophone fills) with modern Tokyo occult hip-hop bounce (syncopated rubbery sub-bass, tight Jersey-club kick-snap pocket, crisp hi-hat triplets, and catchy rhythmic sung/rapped Japanese-English fusion vocals). Warm tape saturation, upbeat yet effortlessly chill sunset cruising mood.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Warm Rhodes sunset chords, vinyl hiss, syncopated rubbery bass pickup)

[Verse 1]
Neon twilight down the train-track street
Spirit meter humming to a midnight beat
Golden ghosts laughing in the rearview glass
Leave the heavy static in the fading past

[Pre-Chorus]
(Snappy Jersey-club kick bounce builds)
Catch the frequency, spin the dial around!

[Chorus]
Ride the spirit wave on a sunset groove
Every hidden shadow starts to catch the move
Homework never ends when the signal's bright
Dancing through the alley till the morning light!

[Bridge]
(Smoky tenor sax solo gliding over warm Rhodes + sub bounce)

[Final Chorus]
Ride the spirit wave on a sunset groove
Ninety-three nostalgia with a brand-new move!

[Outro]
(Solo sax phrase + Rhodes fade)

tracks.title: SPIRIT DETECTIVE BOUNCE (Monetization-Safe Beat)
tracks.genre: Anime Sunset Synth-Jazz x Bouncy Lo-Fi Groove
tracks.cueNotes: Loopable instrumental companion designed for gameplay commentary ducking (-20 dB) and Shorts hooks.
tracks.prompt: 112 BPM in D minor, pure instrumental, seamless loop. Warm 90s anime ending-credits Fender Rhodes chords and nostalgic Stratocaster clean guitar accents locked onto a bouncy modern anime opening hip-hop pocket (tight punchy kick, crisp rimshot snap, agile melodic slap/synth bass, subtle playful vocal-like synth whistle hook). Zero lead vocals, wide midrange space for commentary, effortlessly chill and catchy.
